lane: زغرد زغردة زَغْرَدَةٌ The braying that is reiterated (L, K) in the fauces, or throat, (L,) or in the جَوْف [meaning chest], (K,) of the camel: (L, K:) an inf. n., of which the verb is زَغْرَدَ: you say, زَغْرَدَ البَعِيرُ. (TK.) === Hence the زَغْرَدَة of women on the occasions of rejoicings. (TA.) [One says, of a woman, زَغْرَدَتْ, more commonly in the present day زَغْرَطَتْ, meaning She uttered shrill, quavering, or rapidly-reiterated, sounds, or cries of joy: which sounds, or cries, are termed ↓زَغَارِيدُ, and now more commonly زَغَارِيط.] زغاريد زَغَارِيدُ : see above.

entries.text: زغرد: الزَّغْرَدَةُ: هدير يردده الفحل في حلقه.|
الزغردة: هدير للإبل يردده في جوفه.
